title: Caliban
summary: Caliban is a powerful and rare Meso-Titan who possesses the fury of an Aztec warrior. This masked warrior, like the lion, represented power and fierceness to the Aztec people. Due to Caliban's strong will, only a very strong and talented Seeker can bond with this Titan. Caliban is closely related to the Caliban Ocean Warrior Titans used by the Casterwill family.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Caliban inspired many legends about mighty warriors and vengeful spirits in Central America based on the sightings of these Titans by the native people, particularly the Aztecs. [Huntik.com] Two of the Aztec rulers used two Caliban Amulets in order to conquer their enemies to expand their empires. [The School of Mystery]

One Caliban Amulet was later found by the Huntik Foundation operative Simon Judeau who used it to save the life of his friend Metz at the Temple of Tecobai. [The Divine Comedy] Metz eventually obtained Simon's Amulet and later gave it to his young charge, Dante Vale, during a trip to Turkey. [Ladies' Choice] Dante took more than a year to learn how to summon and use Caliban in battle because this Titan is hard to control due to its willful and aggressive nature. [Huntik.com] Caliban, having powers rivaling even some Legendary Titans, requires a vast amount of energy from his Seeker, and through training, under his old martial arts mentor, Master Storm, Dante went from only being able to summon Caliban for about a minute to being able to summon the Titan for longer durations. [Lok's Leadership]

Some years later, Dante discovered another Caliban Amulet in South America, during one of his most dangerous missions for the Huntik Foundation. [Caliban Amulet] Dante kept this a secret, with everyone believing he possessed simply the one Caliban, who had become his most distinctive Titan. [The Mission]

During the battle at the the Professor's castle, Dante summoned Caliban to fight Rassimov's Ammit Heart-Eater. Caliban then fought with Thornment, but was sent back to his Amulet by one of the spiked traps set up by Rassimov. Later, during the team's showdown with the Professor, Dante was manipulated by Simon into giving back his original Caliban Amulet along with the Rings of Behemoth and Tao, believing it would help to save Metz. [The Divine Comedy] Dante later revealed to Zhalia Moon that he had always possessed two Calibans, and invoked his "spare" Caliban to fight and defeat one of the Undergolem Titans. [The Mission]

During the battle in Klaus' bookshop with the newly-returned Rassimov and his Blood Spiral forces, overpowered and injured, Dante managed to save himself by Powerbonding with Caliban. Powerbonded Caliban used his sword to deflect Rassimov's Bladewave attack onto Wind and a Silent Soldier. He then used one of Dante's moves on Harlekin, throwing him into a Marauder and taking it out, before defeating Harlekin with his sword. [The Blood Spiral]

During his secret training in China under Master Storm, Dante trained with Caliban alongside him with the pair taking on many intense training drills. [Lok's Leadership]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E06 Caliban.jpg|thumb|Caliban strikes to take out an opponent]]
Caliban's ferocious attitude makes his martial arts execution be more reckless than those of Titans such as [[Sabriel]] and [[Freelancer]]. This unpredictable nature gives him an enormous advantage against more formal combat styles. He bears armor of the finest quality and possesses a variety of weapons including his iconic massive, powerful blade, a spiked mace, {{source|The Legacy of Thor}}, a dagger {{Source|The Treasures of the Argonauts}} and a double-sided, barbed spear. {{Source|All Work and No Pay}} His strength and combat versatility combined with his speed and agility make up a Titan that is formidable in any situation. Because of his power, Caliban Titans have been used to cause the rise and fall of whole empires at the hands of many [[Seekers]], both good and evil, and to shape the future of Earth. {{Source|Huntik.com}}

sections.heading: Powerbonding
sections.text:
Image caption: Dante and Powerbonded Caliban train together in perfect sync

When the bond with his Seeker became stronger Caliban obtained a stronger appearance with golden armor, longer hair, and an energy blade. Like the other Powerbonded Titans, now he can communicate telepathically with his Seeker. His Powerbonded abilities include:
• Breaking Charge - enables him to charge at enemies across different terrain including water. [Zhalia's Mission]
• Leaping Slash - enables him to jump through the air and hit an enemy with his sword. [Den vs Harrison]
• Mirror Fight - allows him to fight perfectly in sync with his Seeker. [Den vs Harrison]
• Rayflector - reflects and redirects incoming spells. [The Power of Umbra]
• Synchronized Strike - hits an enemy in perfect sync with his Seeker. [Den vs Harrison]

sections.heading: Design History
sections.wikitext:
Caliban was designed to be a powerful and exotic Titan. Though originally designed more like a samurai, his design later took more influence from an Aztec warrior. His arms were given spikes, and his face was covered by a strange mask. He was given long hair akin to that of a lion as well as a more cybernetic appearance. Throughout the designing process, the core of Caliban has been his skill and prowess. {{source|Huntik.com}}
